Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical pages sixteen to twenty-one, of the private snapshot of the Connecticut Driver’s Manual edition dated on its imprint page, the issuer’s own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: clock positions, look-ahead seconds, passing feet, fines, speeds, distances, time windows and right-of-way orders are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual.
Accuracy flags: none; the basics, crossing, zone and road-sharing texts on physical pages sixteen to twenty-one extracted readably, and no page in the range was unreadable.
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published driving rules for exam preparation only.
